# hpe_opsramp_role (Data Source)

Looks up an OpsRamp Role by name. Returns its numeric ID and unique UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_opsramp_role" "administrator" {
  name = "Client Administrator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role to look up.

### Optional

- `client` (String) Optional client (tenant) UUID to query against. Defaults to the provider tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the role.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the role.
